, a skinner trainer in action.]] Skinners are artisans and craftmen who ensure that nothing goes to waste by removing the hides of dead beasts and amassing piles of fur and leather. on the Isle of Dorn.]] Skippers are amphibious fish found on the Isle of Dorn and many of the underground realms of Azeroth, primarily in Harandar and the Ringing Deeps. Skyboxes are types of skies that typically appear in zones with an open sky. A skybox loads in every area of the game, even those where the sky is nowhere visible. Despite the name, most skyboxes in World of Warcraft are not box models around a zone, and will appear anywhere they are defined in the game's code to appear, no matter how far out. Some skyboxes change depending on the time of day or weather. Some examples of skyboxes are the fiery skybox seen in the Burning Steppes, a skybox with aurora seen several places in Northrend, a skybox with the Twisting Nether seen in Outland, and many others.

Slateback Fur is gathered from Slateback Roamers in Eco-Dome: Primus. Hemet Nesingwary wants two samples for Medical Checkup as part of Ecological Succession.

Slateback Soccer was first made available in the second half of the week of 19 November 2025. This concludes the "Roaming Free" chapter of Otherworldly Ecologist. The next chapter begins immediately after with Fox Bane and Lapbug Essence Hunter from Ve'nari.
